items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: With Diz – “I got to go. Lorraine called. I have to go.”

I just want to talk – talk about the people that you knew. Art Farmer, Gigi. When you went with Diz – I’m going to switch gears with you, but it’s going to involve these people. When I interviewed Art Farmer, he talked about how, at this time in the early to mid-’50s, that jazz musicians started to come up with the idea of getting their own publishing rights. When Art told me, he said it was Gigi.
